purpose: Reference-only literature map for phylogenetic search and seed prioritization.

families.label: hypergraph-product
families.construction: CSS homological product of two classical parity-check complexes.
families.repo_gap: Current constructor is a 1x2 group-algebra specialization; general 2x2 classical inputs are not yet represented.

primary_sources.title: Quantum LDPC codes with positive rate and minimum distance proportional to n^1/2

families.accelerator_route: Add a native sparse 2x2 product builder; reuse packed CSS RIS and exact verifier gates.

families.label: quantum expander
families.construction: Hypergraph-product codes paired with an expansion-based linear-time decoder.
families.repo_gap: No explicit expander graph/classical-code generator or decoder benchmark in this repo.

primary_sources.title: Quantum Expander Codes

families.accelerator_route: Use the C++ packed kernel for candidate distance screens; add graph generation separately.

families.label: fiber-bundle
families.construction: A generalized homological product in which a code is assembled as a fiber bundle.
families.repo_gap: Requires chain-complex and bundle data structures, not only group-algebra 1x2 pairs.

primary_sources.title: Fiber Bundle Codes: Breaking the N^1/2 polylog(N) Barrier for Quantum LDPC Codes

families.accelerator_route: Sparse matrix ingestion first; C++ distance kernels can operate after construction.

families.label: balanced-product
families.construction: Amalgamation of classical codes and Ramanujan-graph structure through a balanced product.
families.repo_gap: Current group-product constructor does not encode the graph/coset amalgamation rules.

primary_sources.title: Balanced Product Quantum Codes

families.accelerator_route: Keep graph construction in Python initially; hand packed H_X/H_Z to native CSS RIS.

families.label: lifted-product
families.construction: Lifted product of matrices over a group algebra; current repo searches a systematic 1x2 CSS slice.
families.repo_gap: Broader base matrices, non-regular actions, and paper-specific symmetry constraints are not yet covered.

primary_sources.title: Quantum LDPC Codes with Almost Linear Minimum Distance

families.accelerator_route: Native batch systematic seeds plus native CSS RIS; exact native Tanner search for n <= 384.

families.label: generalized-bicycle
families.construction: Two polynomial/group-algebra blocks generalizing bicycle codes beyond a single cyclic group.
families.repo_gap: Existing search does not yet include the full published GB parameter/catalog space.

primary_sources.title: Degenerate Quantum LDPC Codes With Good Finite Length Performance
Generalized bicycle quantum LDPC codes

families.accelerator_route: Enumerate polynomial supports in the existing group engine; batch systematic screening in C++.

families.label: bivariate-bicycle
families.construction: Bicycle-style CSS codes over a product of two cyclic groups.
families.repo_gap: Needs two-dimensional cyclic polynomial representation and optional perturbed/non-CSS branch.

primary_sources.title: High-threshold and low-overhead fault-tolerant quantum memory
Evolutionary Discovery of Bivariate Bicycle Codes with LLM-Guided Search

families.accelerator_route: Implement torus-indexed supports, then reuse packed RIS; keep non-CSS out of CSS-only paths.

families.label: two-block group algebra (2BGA)
families.construction: Smallest lifted-product codes over arbitrary finite groups, including non-abelian groups.
families.repo_gap: Full catalog and permutation-equivalence reduction are not imported; current search samples a narrower 1x2 form.

primary_sources.title: Quantum two-block group algebra codes

families.accelerator_route: Use cached finite-group tables and native batch systematic generation; import catalog supports only after local validation.

families.label: coset-based two-block codes
families.construction: Two-block codes from group actions on cosets, extending regular 2BGA actions.
families.repo_gap: Requires coset-action permutation matrices rather than regular group multiplication tables.

primary_sources.title: Breaking the bicycle frame: Coset-based quantum LDPC codes

families.accelerator_route: Generalize qldpc_batch_systematic to arbitrary permutation actions; preserve verifier-derived weights.

families.label: quantum Tanner
families.construction: Two compatible Tanner codes on a left-right Cayley complex.
families.repo_gap: Needs square-complex incidence and local-code constraints; group pair search is not equivalent.

primary_sources.title: Quantum Tanner codes
Decoding quantum Tanner codes
Small quantum Tanner codes from left-right Cayley complexes

families.accelerator_route: Add sparse square-complex builder and native syndrome/logical kernels; current RIS remains reusable.

families.label: Kasai APM
families.construction: Affine/permutation-matrix CSS constructions controlling active orthogonality and Tanner-graph girth.
families.repo_gap: Current engine assumes finite-group algebra supports, not arbitrary affine permutation matrices.

primary_sources.title: Breaking the Orthogonality Barrier in Quantum LDPC Codes
Heuristic Search for Minimum-Distance Upper-Bound Witnesses in Quantum APM-LDPC Codes

families.accelerator_route: Represent permutations as packed sparse row maps; C++ RIS can screen large matrices after construction.

families.label: affine-coset CPM lift
families.construction: (3,8)-regular affine-coset base pair followed by CPM lifting.
families.repo_gap: Base permutation construction and large CPM lifts are outside current 1x2 group search.

primary_sources.title: High-Girth Regular Quantum LDPC Codes from Affine-Coset Structures

families.accelerator_route: Use streaming sparse supports and native RIS; do not run exact search at these n.

families.label: GALA
families.construction: Group-Action Lifts with Active orthogonality over a small non-abelian factor and cyclic factor.
families.repo_gap: Existing non-abelian group engine may cover only a narrow algebraic slice; GALA schedules/layouts are absent.

primary_sources.title: Designer Codes from GALA: Compact, Self-Dual, and Rate-1/2 QEC on Reconfigurable Atom Arrays

families.accelerator_route: Search GALA support templates with the native batch path; locality must be independently laid out and verified.

families.label: mitten
families.construction: Non-abelian lifted-product processor codes at design rate 1/5 and check weight 9.
families.repo_gap: Paper-specific group/support catalogs and processor layouts are not yet imported.

primary_sources.title: High-rate qLDPC processors

families.accelerator_route: Directly compatible with 1x2 non-abelian support enumeration; prioritize n=300/500/540 and fresh-seed confirmation.

families.label: ZSZ-LP
families.construction: Balanced products of rate-1/2 classical LDPC codes sharing non-abelian semidirect-product symmetry.
families.repo_gap: Current search does not encode the shared-classical-code design constraints or published instance table.

primary_sources.title: Quantum LDPC codes with design rate 1/5 and good performance below 1000 physical qubits

families.accelerator_route: Add semidirect support templates, then use native systematic batches and CSS RIS.

families.label: tile/planar
families.construction: Planar or directional tile-code constructions with explicit geometric layouts.
families.repo_gap: Current candidates are unrestricted algebraic codes; no boundary/layout generator.

Planar weight-8 qLDPC reference
Strictly nearest-neighbour directional-tile reference

families.construction: Generalized toric/bicycle constructions on twisted tori.
families.repo_gap: Requires geometric boundary/twist representation rather than only group support pairs.

families.accelerator_route: Convert layouts to sparse supports, then use native verification/refutation only.

families.label: LLM-evolved BB/PBB ansatz
families.construction: Evolutionary program mutation over bivariate-bicycle and perturbed bivariate-bicycle ansätze.

families.label: golden/hyperbolic
families.construction: Homological codes from regular tessellations of hyperbolic 4-manifolds.
families.repo_gap: No manifold/tessellation input layer; likely outside current finite-group target regime.

families.accelerator_route: Treat as a future sparse-matrix import family, not a current search branch.

families.construction: Bicycle supports selected from divisor/factor structure of cyclic or small-group actions.
families.repo_gap: Current random support sampler ignores divisor structure and small-group census constraints.

families.repo_gap: Current regular representation cannot enumerate subgroup coset actions or cover lifts.
